scope: Task 12c3c final native artifact review: four fresh consumer trees and eight Debug/Release executions, static research core with static/shared fmt across P2996 and GCC16.

observed_native_evidence.compiler_and_sdk: Generated compiler files, caches and actual compile/link commands match each retained dependency lane: Clang 21.0.0 or GNU 16.2.0, macOS SDK/deployment 27.0, ARM64, C++26. Reflection is enabled on the real core; fmt is a compiled imported target.
observed_native_evidence.fmt_selection: Exact retained configuration-specific target path and kind; four dynamic consumers load precisely the selected fmt dylib, and four static consumers load no fmt dylib.
observed_native_evidence.runtime_selection: P2996 commands explicitly link the fork libc++/libc++abi/libunwind and all four P2996 traces contain their qualified paths. All four GCC traces contain the qualified libstdc++ path. System libc++, libc++abi and libunwind also appear in every trace.

static_artifact_review.three_documentation_deltas: Accurately report native success and retain final review as pending.

reviewer_checks.activity: One filesystem/text comparison with AST literal reading; no candidate function or native tool execution.

limits: Loader evidence proves selected lane runtime presence and successful witness behavior; it does not prove absence of system C++ runtimes or symbol-level binding exclusivity.
Only Debug/Release, static core and the four retained fmt triplets are exercised; broader presets, instrumentation, export/relocation and later tasks are outside this gate.

Native runs, lipo, dependency/tool binaries, source inventories, guards, PID/lease/default-profile/capacity checks, baseline tests and scanner were not rerun. Closure preservation is supported by the bound native report and retained parent closure.
Fresh model sessions, providers and full Claude/container acceptance were not run.
